```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(gt)
library(readr)
library(ggplot2)
```
#load health data
```{r}
rhinovirus <- read_csv("data/ukhsa-chart-download-rhinovirus.csv")

gt(head(rhinovirus))
```

```{r}
weather <- read_csv("data/weather_data.csv")
ggplot(weather)
```
```{r}
ggplot(weather, aes(
  x = observation_time,
  y = temperature_c
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "red") +
  xlab("Date") +
  ylab("Temp (C)") +
  ggtitle("Temperature by Date")
```
#plot health data
```{r}
ggplot(rhinovirus, aes(
  x = date,
  y = metric_value
)) +
  geom_line(colour = "green")+
  ylab ("percentage") +
  xlab ("date") +
  ggtitle("percentage of positive test results for rhinovirus")
  

```
